subject.title: [Feature]: Slim the Skill Workshop system-prompt section; move mechanics into the tool schema

question: Should OpenClaw accept the slimmer Skill Workshop prompt/schema split in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100481 as the intended model-facing routing contract?
rationale: The implementation is small, but it changes model-facing safety and product tone around a governed skill-write boundary, and the live issue has the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Proceed with the narrow prompt/schema split once the PR includes real prompt/schema output proving the reduced text and preserved routing contract.

options.title: Tighten wording first
options.body: Ask the PR to add or adjust one concise lifecycle-boundary sentence before approval if maintainers want stronger redundancy.

options.title: Keep verbose guardrails
options.body: Leave the current repeated prompt instructions if maintainers prefer redundancy over token savings and softer wording for this boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with the narrow prompt/schema split once the PR includes real prompt/schema output proving the reduced text and preserved routing contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the live issue assignment and authored the open candidate implementation, making him the strongest available owner for the wording/product choice.
